# VPN panel 5X-UEV

> Free open-source web panel for a personal VPN server on Ubuntu 20.04/22.04/24.04, made for beginners without Linux experience. Installation runs in the browser with a progress bar; the first VLESS + Reality profile works over the server IP without a domain. With a domain it adds VLESS xHTTP, Hysteria 2, NaiveProxy and Mieru on port 443, plus Cloudflare WARP. An optional second VPS acts as an OpenVPN relay (cascade VPN) that forwards traffic to the main server over Reality or xHTTP.

Key facts:
- Install on a clean Ubuntu VPS as root: `bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pasnya/vpn-panel-5x-uev/v0.9.4/install.sh)"`, then open the printed `https://SERVER_IP:8444/?token=...` link. Add `--auto` to install without the browser.
- Relay install on a second VPS: `bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pasnya/vpn-panel-5x-uev/v0.9.4/proxy_panel/install.sh)"`, then paste the printed connection string into the main panel.
- No domain needed for VLESS + Reality. xHTTP, Hysteria 2, NaiveProxy, Mieru and the single subscription link require a domain; the panel checks DNS before issuing a Let's Encrypt certificate.
- The relay passes TCP and DNS; other UDP is blocked, so UDP games/calls should use direct Reality or Hysteria 2 profiles.
- Manages one server (plus relay). For multi-node VPN services with hundreds of users, Marzban or Remnawave fit better.
- Recommended clients: Anarise VPN (Windows, Android); Shadowrocket, Streisand, sing-box (iPhone); Nekoray/Nekobox, sing-box (macOS); any OpenVPN client for the relay `.ovpn` file.

## Docs (Russian)

- [Overview and install](https://pasnya.github.io/vpn-panel-5x-uev/): what the panel does and the install command
- [Connecting clients](https://pasnya.github.io/vpn-panel-5x-uev/clients.html): which link to use and which app per platform
- [Cascade relay](https://pasnya.github.io/vpn-panel-5x-uev/cascade-relay.html): OpenVPN relay → Reality/xHTTP setup in two steps
- [Protocols](https://pasnya.github.io/vpn-panel-5x-uev/protocols.html): Reality, xHTTP, Hysteria 2, NaiveProxy, Mieru on one port 443
- [Panel comparison](https://pasnya.github.io/vpn-panel-5x-uev/compare.html): 5X-UEV vs 3x-ui, Marzban, Remnawave
- [FAQ](https://pasnya.github.io/vpn-panel-5x-uev/faq.html): troubleshooting, SSH tunnel login, DNS and ports
